was: Family campground on the Upper Delaware River at Equinunk (Wayne County), just above Kellam's Bridge.  Only ten sites suit RVs, for trailers up to 40 ft on narrow, uneven roads; the full-hookup sites are seasonal.  Priced per person plus a site fee ($22 an adult a night and $12 for water and electric on the operator's page headed '2023 Rates'); riverfront sites need at least 6 adults and creekside sites 4, and some RV sites carry a 3-adult minimum. --Claude
